text:
jordan_acme: Hey team, quick one — I lost edit access to the 'payments' project in the console this morning. Trying to change environment vars and I get a 403. API deploys using the same service key still work. We had an IdP group rename/SCIM tweak around 08:30 PT. Could that be related?

maria_support: hi @jordan_acme :wave: — sorry about that. Can you paste the exact error you see in the console and confirm if this affects multiple users or just you? Also, can you try in an incognito window to rule out cached tokens?

jordan_acme: incognito same 403. Error toast: "You do not have permission to update project settings (403)". API calls for deploy return 200. It's only me and one other contributor who got affected. We used to be in a group named "acme-redwood-payments-admins-v2" which the IdP renamed to "acme-redwood-payments-admins" (dropped suffix). I can share the debug JWT if helpful.

maria_support: thanks. tagging infra/eng -> @alex_eng for permission/claim mapping look. Can you share a masked JWT claim payload (groups claim) and approximate time of IdP change? We'll escalate if repro.

alex_eng: thanks @maria_support — logging into the provisioning audit now. Two quick asks: 1) paste the groups claim (just the array) from the token, 2) did your SCIM provisioning change include a max-length transformation or a custom naming rule?

jordan_acme: here's the groups claim (masked):
```json
["acme-users", "acme-redwood-payments-admins", "acme-ci"]
```
SCIM provisioning shows a recent profile transform on Okta that removes trailing tags. Not sure about length limits. Change time ~2023-11-17T08:28:12Z (our clock).

akex_eng: (typo) Alex: i checked the provisioning logs — okta-scim-bot shows that when the group rename happened the SCIM mapping truncated some group names in the internal identity record to 32 chars, so our role-claim matcher didn't match the exact admin group name and the user lost console role binding. API service keys still worked because they are separate auth paths.

okta-scim-bot: SCIM provisioning event: group update id=grp_98765, name change from "acme-redwood-payments-admins-v2" to "acme-redwood-payments-admins" at 2023-11-17T08:28:12Z. Truncated name stored: "acme-redwood-payments-admins" (32/32).

sre-bot: Perms engine audit: user jordan_acme had project:payments role binding via groupName exact-match -> failed on lookup after provisioning update. Fallbacks attempted: none matched.

alex_eng: root cause: role bindings on the console require the exact IdP group -> internal group name mapping. Because the group record changed and our tolerant-matcher didn't cover the trimmed form, the binding effectively orphaned. Short-term workaround: add jordan_acme directly to the project-admins group or recreate a group mapping that matches the current SCIM name. Long-term: update provisioning transform to preserve canonical group name OR make our role matcher accept prefix matches for known group prefixes.

maria_support: steps to mitigate — I've posted a ticket to enterprise-support (ES-94512). Alex, can you provide the console API curl to add a user to the project admins while we triage? I'll ask Jordan if they want us to apply the workaround.

alex_eng: sure. Example (mask your api token):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/payments/members \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"member":"jordan_acme","role":"project:admin"}'
```
This will re-add the user directly until we restore group-based binding. Also, if you prefer group-based fix, add the current IdP group (acme-redwood-payments-admins) to the project via console -> Project settings -> Members -> Add group.

jordan_acme: I tried the curl approach with maria_support on a test user and it fixed edit access immediately. Please apply to my account.

maria_support: applying workaround now, will update ticket.

alex_eng: engineering follow-up: we'll deploy a tolerant-matcher patch to accept the common suffix-less group pattern for project admin groups (short-term) and open a change request to prefer canonical group IDs from SCIM (long-term). ETA for tolerant patch: ~2 business days, will be behind a small feature flag.

maria_support: noted. @jordan_acme I've updated ES-94512 with the workaround applied and your confirmation. Can you verify you can edit everything you need and then close here? :white_check_mark:

jordan_acme: confirmed, I can edit settings again. Thanks for the fast turnaround, much appreciated.

maria_support: thanks for confirming! We'll keep the ticket open while engineering rolls the patch and notify you before we change anything else. If you see the group renaming propagate to more users, ping this thread and we'll escalate to on-call.

alex_eng: engineering note for internal follow-up: check SCIM attribute size config on the Okta transform (max-length=32) and our role-binding lookup logic. We should be resilient to common idp name trims. I'll create a PR and link to ES-94512.

maria_support: ES-94512 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ES-94512 — keeping this open until patch verified. Thanks everyone.
